nodes.description: Mapping(address => uint256) tracking the ETH principal invested by each address; used to compute profit.
Mapping(address => uint256) storing the last investment/withdrawal timestamp; drives time-based profit accrual.
Mapping(address => uint256) holding accrued affiliate commissions payable to referrers, dev and promoter.
Hardcoded developer address receiving a share of every investment commission.
Hardcoded promoter address receiving a share of every investment commission.
Payable entry point that credits investment, pays owed profit via transfer and distributes commissions.
Public function that computes accrued profit and sends it to msg.sender via transfer.
View wrapper returning getProfit(msg.sender).
View function computing profit from seconds elapsed, investedETH and the constant 345600 using SafeMath.
Public function compounding accrued profit back into investedETH without an external transfer.
View function returning the affiliate commission of msg.sender.
Public function zeroing and paying the affiliate commission of msg.sender via transfer.
View function returning investedETH[msg.sender].
View function returning the contract balance.
Private pure helper returning the smaller of two values.
Private pure helper returning the larger of two values.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath integer division.
SafeMath subtraction asserting b <= a.
SafeMath addition asserting no overflow.
Caller-controlled address used as the key for balances, timestamps and all outgoing transfers.
Block timestamp (now) used to accrue profit and to stamp lastInvest.
msg.sender.transfer(profit) inside investETH; external call reaching an untrusted address.
msg.sender.transfer(profit) inside withdraw; external call reaching an untrusted address.
msg.sender.transfer(commision) inside withdrawAffiliateCommision; external call reaching an untrusted address.
Referrer address parameter of investETH used to credit affiliateCommision.
Customer address parameter of getProfit whose balances are read.
Local profit value computed and transferred inside investETH.
Local copy of msg.value used as the invested amount.
Local commission value (amount/20) distributed to referrer, dev and promoter.
Local elapsed-seconds value derived from now - lastInvest[customer].
Local profit value transferred out in withdraw.
Local profit value compounded into investedETH in reinvestProfit.
Local cached affiliate commission transferred out in withdrawAffiliateCommision.
First parameter a of min.
Second parameter b of min.
First parameter a of max.
Second parameter b of max.

edges.reason: investETH reads and writes state keyed by msg.sender.
withdraw uses msg.sender to select profit and pay out.
getProfitFromSender passes msg.sender to getProfit.
getProfit is invoked with msg.sender as the customer.
reinvestProfit reads profit and balances of msg.sender.
getAffiliateCommision reads the mapping entry of msg.sender.
withdrawAffiliateCommision reads, zeroes and pays msg.sender commission.
getInvested returns investedETH[msg.sender].
investETH calls getProfit(msg.sender) to determine owed profit.
withdraw calls getProfit(msg.sender) to determine owed profit.
getProfitFromSender forwards to getProfit.
reinvestProfit calls getProfit(msg.sender).
getProfit derives secondsPassed directly from now (block.timestamp).
getProfit reads lastInvest[customer] to compute elapsed time.
getProfit reads investedETH[customer] as profit basis.
getProfit uses SafeMath.sub for now - lastInvest.
getProfit uses SafeMath.mul for secondsPassed * investedETH.
getProfit uses SafeMath.div by 345600.
lastInvest is stamped with now, making profit accrual timestamp dependent.
investETH writes lastInvest[msg.sender] = now before and after payment.
withdraw resets lastInvest[msg.sender] = now.
reinvestProfit resets lastInvest[msg.sender] = now.
investETH executes msg.sender.transfer(profit) before finalizing all state writes.
The external transfer can re-enter investETH through the recipient's fallback function.
withdraw performs an external transfer to msg.sender.
The transfer in withdraw can be used to re-enter the contract.
withdrawAffiliateCommision performs an external transfer to msg.sender.
The commission transfer can re-enter the contract via the recipient.
Local profit value is the amount passed to the external transfer in investETH.
Local profit value is the amount passed to the external transfer in withdraw.
Local commission value is the amount passed to the external transfer.
referral parameter is consumed by investETH.
customer parameter is consumed by getProfit.
referral address is used to credit affiliateCommision.
investETH increases affiliateCommision for referral, dev and promoter.
investETH increases investedETH[msg.sender] by the sent amount.
investETH credits commission to the dev address.
investETH credits commission to the promoter address.
investETH divides the amount by 20 using SafeMath.div.
investETH uses SafeMath.add for all balance increments.
reinvestProfit uses SafeMath.add to compound profit.
reinvestProfit adds profit into investedETH[msg.sender].
Local profit value is compounded by reinvestProfit.
withdrawAffiliateCommision reads and zeroes affiliateCommision[msg.sender].
getAffiliateCommision reads affiliateCommision[msg.sender].
getInvested reads investedETH[msg.sender].
Local amount holds msg.value used by investETH.
Local commission is computed and distributed by investETH.
Local secondsPassed is derived inside getProfit.
min reads parameter a.
min reads parameter b.
max reads parameter a.
max reads parameter b.

normalization_plan.reason: The referral parameter only exists to credit affiliateCommision inside investETH, so it can be folded into that function.
The customer parameter is only a local alias for the address whose balances getProfit reads.
The local profit value is exactly the value sent by the external transfer in investETH.
Local amount is a trivial copy of msg.value inside investETH before it is added to investedETH.
Local commission is derived from the sent value and distributed entirely within investETH.
Local secondsPassed is an intermediate timestamp difference computed only in getProfit.
The local profit value is exactly the value sent by the external transfer in withdraw.
Local profit is only used to increase investedETH inside reinvestProfit.
The cached commission value is exactly the value sent by the external transfer in withdrawAffiliateCommision.
Parameter a of the helper min only exists for that trivial comparison function.
Parameter b of the helper min only exists for that trivial comparison function.
Parameter a of the helper max only exists for that trivial comparison function.
Parameter b of the helper max only exists for that trivial comparison function.
